description: Defines a template class 'linked_ptr' implementing a reference-counted smart pointer with circular linked list management, along with internal class 'linked_ptr_internal' for internal list handling. Contains licensing and usage notes.

classes.name: linked_ptr_internal
classes.description: Internal class managing circular linked list pointers for linked_ptr.

classes.name: linked_ptr
classes.description: Template smart pointer class with reference tracking via circular linked list.

methods.name: join_new
methods.description: Creates a new circular list with only this instance.

methods.name: depart
methods.description: Removes this instance from its circular list; deletes managed object if last.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns from another linked_ptr, managing list and object lifetime.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Replaces managed object with a new raw pointer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer to the managed object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the managed object.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the managed object, returning the raw pointer.
